newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel prices off, but USG market active.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel prices off, but USG market active.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices eased with NYMEX heating oil futures, but activity at the key U.S. Gulf Coast production region was active enough to keep cash differentials from sliding as well, traders said.

At least four deals totalling about 100,000 barrels for airline-quality 54-grade jet fuel were heard done at 1.25 cents over October heating oil futures, or about 67.25 cents a gallon -- about 0.50 cent weaker than on Friday.
Prices in New York Harbor were about a cent weaker with bids on 54-grade sliding about 0.50 cent to 4.50 cents over October futures, traders said.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
